scope: First Windows desktop slice for one embedded GLSL fragment pass, authored per channel.

verified.software: Generated media contracts, MapGyver and Chataigne UI type checks, focused Media creation tests, strict app and Golden Video library Clippy, and the default Windows app build passed.
verified.hardware: A D3D11 readback matched all four expected 2x2 pixels at each of two show times, including discarded pixels and exact premultiplied alpha.
verified.app: WebView2 created Shader Media and committed literal GLSL braces through the Inspector. An independent Spout receiver captured the expected blue across all 96x64 pixels with alpha 127 for nominal half alpha.

isolatedApp.startupDisplay: RTK FHD HDR, Windows GDI display 2
isolatedApp.pixels: A separate Spout receiver verified five complete 96x64 frames. The first was blue with alpha 127 for nominal half alpha. Invalid code cleared the output, valid code restored green, an unsaved edit produced red, and loading the saved project restored green.
